title: Signal and Machine
author: Vesper Sandoval
blurb: Wendell Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
